cases.message: Can I eat chocolate while taking Mounjaro?
cases.answer: According to the Cambridge University Hospitals guidance on food with tirzepatide (Mounjaro) [1], there is no specific mention of chocolate. The guidance suggests eating bland, low-fat foods to help with nausea and stopping when full. It also advises avoiding fatty or spicy food to help with heartburn. However, this is general guidance and does not guarantee that a particular food will suit an individual. There is no chocolate-specific permission or waiting time after an injection mentioned in the guidance. It's essential to note that individual suitability and tolerance to certain foods while taking Mounjaro may vary. The UK authorisation and NHS access information for Mounjaro [2, 3] does not provide specific guidance on food choices, including chocolate. As a general precaution, it's recommended to consult with a healthcare professional for personalized advice on food choices while taking Mounjaro. In your case, since you have chosen a Synthetic Lentil Bowl for today, you may want to consider how you feel after eating that meal before introducing other foods like chocolate.
